column1: # firstmate-config stack compatibility manifest.
# The single source of truth for stable compatibility information across
# OMP Captain -> official FirstMate -> Herdr -> Pi / OMP, on macOS and
# Betao/Omarchy Linux. install.sh and bin/fm-doctor both read this file
# through firstmate/fm-stack-manifest.sh, the one parsing/comparison owner -
# never duplicate these values as separate hardcoded constants in a script
# or a test.
# Deliberately excluded (see README "Boundaries" and AGENTS.md): auth,
# credentials, machine paths, Betao settings, the project registry, Portail
# data, runtime task state, and Captain model routing - those stay owned by
# crew-dispatch.json, captain-startup-models.tsv, and machine-local state.
# min and tested are equal for every component below: this installation has
# one locally-verified known-good version per component, not a separately
# proven lower bound. A future release that has actually validated a wider
# supported range can lower min below tested; recording a lower min now
# without that evidence would just be a guess, which fm-doctor's own status
# rules (README "fm doctor") forbid.
# firstmate_validated_commit is the full commit hash, not a short one:
# fm-doctor and install.sh reason about it with `git merge-base
# --is-ancestor` (firstmate/fm-stack-manifest.sh:stack_commit_relation),
# which needs an unambiguous object id.
# To move a pin: verify the new values against a real installation, change
# them below, and commit. This file is tracked; nothing here is
# machine-local state.
# The Agent Library pin (library_repo, library_commit and library_tree: all
# three or none). install.sh step 10 fetches exactly library_commit from
# library_repo, requires its tree to be library_tree, and installs it at
# ${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/agent-library. library_ref is only a
# fallback for a server that refuses a fetch by commit id, never the pin, and
# no branch head is ever followed: the Library moves only when a reviewed
# change moves these rows. The repository is private; each machine brings
# its own Git read access, never a credential here or in the URL.
# Format, tab-separated key<TAB>value:
schema_version
firstmate_repo
firstmate_validated_commit
pi_min_version
pi_tested_version
omp_min_version
omp_tested_version
herdr_min_version
herdr_tested_version
library_repo
library_commit
library_tree
library_ref
